This '''member''' of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] on [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] was employed as a messenger on [[uvak]]-back in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. In [[4985 BBY]], he reported the mysterious [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of the entire population of the town of [[Rabolow]] to Lost Tribe leader [[Yaru Korsin]].
